families.direction_probability: Frozen regularized logistic classification predicts next-return direction from candle/volume state; classification skill may be too small to cover costs.

families.ordinal_entropy_persistence: Low entropy of three-return ordinal permutations identifies organized paths; the latest three-return direction supplies exposure.
families.run_duration_expectation: Frozen next-return expectation by signed run duration tests persistence/exhaustion beyond the earlier two-sign Markov state.
